test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Ten people are sitting in two parallel rows 1 and 2. A, B, C, D and E are sitting in row 1 facing north, and V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting in row 2 facing south, in such a way that each member in row 1 faces a member of row 2.

A sits second from the right end of the row. W faces an immediate neighbour of A. X sits third to the right of W. The one who faces X, sits to the immediate right of B. Only one person sits between B and C. V sits to the immediate right of Y. D does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the row.

Who faces Z?
solution:
Ten people are sitting in two parallel rows 1 and 2.

__
 
• **A, B, C, D and E** are sitting in row** 1 facing north.**
 
• **V, W, X, Y and Z **are sitting in row **2 facing south.**

1) A sits second from the right end of the row.

2) W faces an immediate neighbour of A.

 
• Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4812b32810ca4fe254d74970809a84cab4eed5d9dd3fdeb18f2e69597e6d3c6d.png] 

 
• Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f963c5e9d240af260508ba965742031b7068d78971c02fbb9fff4b640f6b845.png] 

3) X sits third to the right of W.

4) The **one who**__ faces X, sits to the immediate right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1aec8b68c6c6134cbf43caa6557a0e4edeede014dc566ef5ad7778ea8244f52d.png] 

5) Only one person sits between B and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd77c8a653ee794168d3ecffdc8d339b4c6bc63af419f119d24fc5947e41dc44.png] 

6) V sits to the immediate right of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c25392e7fcfa58100ae6d2d519f696c1be6c6ab67f0af72143d7f9c5aa9b429c.png] 

7) D does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the row.

 
• Thus the final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9ec0f131be581f0e39ebbd5e947c79871c5edf2023dfb00f338aba0a702644e.png] 

∴ Here,** 'Z' is sitting opposite and faces 'B'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"B".**
